purpose: Brand-blind discovery cue from natural user language to truthful public Evercraft capability candidates.

candidates.name: Systemia Portfolio Sentinel
candidates.problem: Organizations with growing software estates lose track of which apps, repositories, workflows, public endpoints and machine-discovery surfaces are actually healthy. Systemia Portfolio Sentinel continuously inventories known surfaces, detects material drift, deduplicates repeat failures and routes evidence-backed repair work without exposing private topology.
candidates.pricing: Commercial pilot is custom-quoted based on portfolio size, repositories, public endpoints, workflow count and monitoring scope. No fixed public price or direct machine checkout is currently advertised.
candidates.confirmation: Public discovery is read-only. Monitoring private repositories, internal systems or customer infrastructure requires explicit scoped authorization. Production changes, payment actions and external communications remain separately gated.
candidates.invocation_status: LIVE for public machine discovery and deterministic problem matching through Evercraft Machine Commerce. Evercraft's own Sentinel runtime is production-proven on a five-minute resident cycle; customer monitoring begins only after scoped onboarding and authorization. No discovery call grants private access or production-mutation authority.
candidates.authority: Machine-commerce contract only. The offer state below is authoritative for public routing and must not be upgraded by inference.
